title: Earthquake Simulator Pro (open_quake_sim) — Japan earthquake, tsunami and EEW simulation
description:
Web-based research-oriented earthquake and tsunami simulation platform for Japan. Faithful GMPE suite — Zhao et al. (2006) for Japan (frozen calibration tables, three-family logic tree), the NGA-West2 four-model tree (BSSA14 / CY14 / CB14 / ASK14, hazardlib-pinned fixtures at 1e-15) for regional crustal events and NGA-Sub (Parker et al. 2022) for regional subduction, with full-period SA tables (0.01-10 s) feeding PSHA/UHS; 1D equivalent-linear site response (Thomson-Haskell + Darendeli curves, SHAKE-91 external benchmark), ensemble uncertainty fields with spatial correlation, kinematic finite-fault sources (Okada DC3D, von Karman slip spectra, segmented/listric geometry), a PSHA engine with conditional spectrum / UHS, hazard deaggregation and BPT time-dependent renewal, regional source models for six global regions (California, Italy, Chile, Taiwan, New Zealand, Ecuador — ComCat-derived GR grids plus UCERF3-derived California characteristic sources, schema v3), a conditional-spectrum broadband synthesis pipeline (SH production line; the P-SV completion arm was executed on a pre-registered quad-double array and retired with frozen negative reports), two-way AMR nonlinear shallow-water tsunami solver with optional Boussinesq dispersion, EEW detection rehearsal, and a real-time monitoring suite (JMA EEW / Kmoni / tsunami / 551 bulletins, live GSN waveforms via a miniSEED STEIM1/2 decoder). All validation results, including negative ones, are frozen in PHYSICS_BENCHMARKS.md and docs/SCIENTIFIC-REPORT.md; per-dataset provenance and licences in public/data-catalog.js.

v7.0.0 closes the 6.7-7.0 research arc: the P-SV horizontal-block production question was closed by a pre-registered 900-realization quad-double gate array (all three band gates FAIL — MEASURED-NO-CURE, permanently research-state; twoTierQd two-tier router shipped as research infrastructure); regional validation expanded to 19 events / 3,235 strong-motion stations plus a three-event regional tsunami scorecard; the UCERF3-derived California characteristic-source PSHA went time-dependent (Field 2015 aperiodicity, OpenSHA-exact probability gains); the J-SHIS comparison was rebuilt on the official eqcode decomposition with the ERC scenario rates re-sourced to primary literature (R8); Ecuador joined as the sixth full-pipeline region; and the npm package ships as open_quake_sim@7.0.0. All changes kept the Japan production paths byte-identical unless a batch explicitly re-froze their anchors.
notes: Trilingual UI (Japanese / English / Chinese; follows the browser language on first visit, switchable at the top of the sidebar). Core simulation targets Japan: JMA intensity scale, JMA tsunami forecast areas, the Japan station network and JMA-style EEW; the realtime monitoring suite tracks Japanese official feeds. A global pilot mode adds real FDSN station packages and a region registry (California / Italy / Chile) with per-package provenance and honest uncalibrated labeling; regional tsunami stays off where no bathymetry package is bundled. Source repository: https://github.com/Dongwu259/open_quake_sim (MIT). This record archives the tagged release; the research manifest (public/data-catalog.js) is the authoritative per-dataset provenance record.
